items.title: Narrow breadth grinding up under a positive-gamma pin cage into the pre-market open
items.note: Market breadth sits well below its broad-market threshold (heatmap 49.85% positive vs 60%, margin -10.15, narrow leadership) while SPY dealer gamma is positive (signedNetGEX +$17.05B, spot 778.38 above the 770.88 flip, call wall 780 / put wall 770) and the latest intraday tape is a one-way Trend day · up auction (VWAP 777). Fewer than half of constituents are participating, yet a pinning, move-dampening dealer structure and an up-auction tape are carrying price higher against a bull-stacked bench (swing 20>50>200) and calm volatility (vol forecast 13.37%, throttle ×1.12). Structurally this is a narrow, gamma-cushioned grind higher rather than a broad, healthy advance — upside is being led by a shrinking cohort while positive gamma muffles the downside. It is an emergent cross-tool divergence, not any single owner read; the cushion lapses and the read flips to break-watch if spot loses the 770.88 flip.
items.method: Cross-tool divergence flag: compare market-heatmap-lab breadthPct against its own 60% broad threshold (sign of the margin), then overlay the options-structure and gamma-trading dealer-gamma sign together with spot-versus-flip position and the intraday-tape session type. Raise the pattern only when breadth is below threshold AND dealer gamma is positive AND spot sits above the flip (pinning) AND the tape is trending up, all against a calm-volatility, bull-stacked bench — flagging a suppressed-volatility grind carried by narrow internals, and inverting to break-watch once spot falls below the flip.
inputs: market-heatmap-lab: breadthPct 49.85, threshold 60, margin -10.15, 134 constituents, leadership narrow
options-structure-lab: signedNetGEX 17046750312.93, flipLevel 770.88, spot 778.38, callWall 780, putWall 770, expectedMove 3.75
gamma-trading-lab: regime positive, scenario pin-to-maxpain, flip 770.88, callWall 780, putWall 770
intraday-tape-lab: sessionType Trend day · up, control Mixed, vwap 777, gapPct 0.3
